title: uefi-release → main
diff:
diff --git a/uefi-release b/uefi-release
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..1e26bb6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/uefi-release
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+
+set -e
+
+build="ppa:ubuntu-uefi-team/ubuntu/ppa"
+proposed="ppa:ubuntu-uefi-team/ubuntu/proposed"
+proposed_public="ppa:ubuntu-uefi-team/ubuntu/proposed-public"
+
+
+run() {
+    echo "+ $@"
+    "$@"
+}
+
+case "$1" in 
+    unembargo)
+        shift
+        for packagesuite in "$@"; do
+            package=${packagesuite%/*}
+            suite=${packagesuite#*/}
+            run ./copy-package --unembargo -b --from $proposed --to $proposed_public $package --suite $suite
+        done
+        ;;
+    promote-to-devel)
+        shift
+        for packagesuite in "$@"; do
+            package=${packagesuite%/*}
+            suite=${packagesuite#*/}
+            run ./copy-package -b --from $proposed_public --to ubuntu $package --to-suite devel-proposed --from-suite $suite
+        done
+        ;;
+    promote-to-primary)
+        shift
+        for packagesuite in "$@"; do
+            package=${packagesuite%/*}
+            suite=${packagesuite#*/}
+            run ./copy-package -b --from $proposed_public --to ubuntu $package --to-suite $suite-proposed --from-suite $suite
+        done
+        ;;
+    *)
+        echo "E: Unknown action $1" >&2
+        echo "Usage: $0 [unembargo|promote-to-primary|promote-to-devel] package/suite..." >&2
+        exit 1
+        ;;
+esac
+
